# OzPerks

> OzPerks is a free cashback comparison app for Australia (iOS and Android). It shows ShopBack, TopCashback and Kick Cashback rates side by side for each store, keeps a history of how rates have moved, sends alerts when a store reaches a target rate, and lists OzBargain deals with the matching cashback.

Key facts:
- Made by Peter Luu, an independent developer in Australia. Not affiliated with any cashback provider or OzBargain.
- Free to download, no account required. Optional premium upgrade in-app.
- Launched in 2025 under the name Pelicash; renamed OzPerks. App store URLs still use the old name.
- As of October 2026: 3,580 downloads, about 500 daily active users, rated 4.7 on Google Play (35 reviews) and 4.6 on the App Store (8 ratings).
- Users still click through and earn cashback via the provider; OzPerks only compares.
- Supports optional ShopBack Plus rates for members.
